basic_info.description: Set on a picturesque tree-lined street, this top floor 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo in a boutique elevator building is filled with natural light and features high ceilings, hardwood floors, and a spacious living room with a fireplace. The expansive great room is ideal for entertaining and flows seamlessly into a remodeled kitchen and opens to a charming private deck ideal for morning coffee or evening unwinding. The primary suite offers a private deck, walk-in closet, and en-suite bath with a shower. A second full bathroom includes a shower-over-tub for added convenience. Additional highlights include owned solar panels (2.88KW system), 1-car independent garage parking with an EV Charger, in-home laundry, elevator access from the garage, dedicated storage closet on the garden level, abundant finished and unfinished bonus spaces with tall ceilings (including a shared media room with full bathroom on garden level), and a charming shared rear garden. With a 96-Walk Score near top-rated restaurants, retail, coffee shops, Golden Gate Park, UCSF & CPMC, this is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey condo building in one of SF's best neighborhoods.
